INTERVAL_DATETIME.description: Date and time of the trading interval (DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS) fixed to the UTC+10 time zone (NEM time)

LOWER_PERFORMANCE.description: Lower performance value in MWHz units (calculated by FPP for that trading interval taken from FPP database)

LOWER_REASON_FLAG.description: The reason flag showing the decision matrix for the lower performance value Supported values are: 0 = Performance is calculated based on good input data 1 = Performance is Null as unit is a Non Primary DUID in the group 2 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group 4 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable 8 = Performance is Null as FM is unreliable 12 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable and FM is unreliable 6 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable 10 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group is Null as FM is unreliable 14 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable  and FM is unreliable

RAISE_PERFORMANCE.description: Raise performance value in MWHz units (calculated by FPP for that trading interval taken from FPP database)

RAISE_REASON_FLAG.description: The reason flag showing the decision matrix for the raise performance value Supported values are: 0 = Performance is calculated based on good input data 1 = Performance is Null as unit is a Non Primary DUID in the group 2 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group 4 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable 8 = Performance is Null as FM is unreliable 12 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable and FM is unreliable 6 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable 10 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group is Null as FM is unreliable 14 = Performance against the Primary DUID representing the group is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable  and FM is unreliable

VERSIONNO.description: Version (FPP run number from the FPP database)
